hero.title:
Live interpretation,
made effortless
hero.subtitle:
One meeting link, one mic button.
Everything else is handled automatically.
hero.trialNote: Try 500 translated characters without signing in. Sign up and get 30 free minutes every month.

captionDemo.title:
Mixed languages in,
one language out
captionDemo.body: Korean, English and Japanese are detected per utterance and streamed straight into captions. Turn on the AI interpreter voice and it sounds like an interpreter sitting next to you.

demo.autoDetectNote: Korean, English and Japanese mixed — each utterance is detected automatically. This is exactly how the product works.

zoom.title: For Zoom calls, the interpreter bot joins for you
zoom.body: Paste a meeting link and the bot joins, interprets the conversation in real time, and posts a caption link into the chat that anyone can open. Nothing to install, nothing to configure.
zoom.point1: Works with Zoom · Teams · Meet · Webex
zoom.point2: Live captions and voice matched to each participant's language
zoom.point3: A side-by-side transcript remains after the meeting

autoDetect.title: Automatic language detection
autoDetect.body: Even meetings mixing three languages are detected per utterance. You only pick the display language.

voiceOut.title: Captions and voice, together
voiceOut.body: Captions stream instantly, and an AI voice can read them aloud like a live interpreter.

records.title: Records, automatically
records.body: A side-by-side transcript remains when you finish. There is no record button to remember.

finalCta.title: Just turn on your mic
finalCta.body: Try it without signing in. 500 characters is all it takes.

login.title: Get started
login.subtitle: Start in 3 seconds with your Google account. No separate sign-up flow.

progress.signingIn: Signing in with your Google account
progress.hint: Please wait a moment — don't close this window.

login.freeNote: 30 free minutes every month. No card required.

failed.title: Sign-in failed
failed.action: Allow popups for this site or try again in a moment.

try.banner: Trial mode — experience the real interpretation quality for 500 translated characters, no sign-in needed.

ended.title: That's the end of the trial
ended.body: What you just saw is the real performance. Sign up for 30 free minutes every month.
ended.freeNote: Starts instantly with your Google account — no card required.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pay for what you use. Honest included minutes instead of fake unlimited.
pricing.freeNote: Every paid plan comes after a free 30 min/month tier. Prices exclude VAT.
pricing.meetingMode: Meeting interpreter bot (Zoom · Teams · Meet · Webex)
pricing.noOverage: No overage billing — we notify you when minutes run out

pro.name: Pro
pro.for: Individuals and freelancers who interpret weekly

business.name: Business
business.for: Companies where the whole team joins

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.pgNote: Payments activate once our payment provider review completes. Apply now to reserve your spot — we'll email you the moment it opens.

reserved.title: Your request is in
reserved.body: We'll email you as soon as payments open. Your free 30 minutes keep working in the meantime.

failed.title: Could not save your request
failed.action: Check your network and try again.

chart.title: Daily usage
chart.empty: Start interpreting and daily usage piles up here.

recent.title: Recent sessions
recent.emptyHint: Start an in-person session and it shows up here. Saved history arrives in Phase 2.

live.title: In-person interpreting
live.consentNotice: This conversation is processed for interpretation and records.

setup.autoDetectFixed: The spoken language is detected per utterance. Mixed languages are all interpreted into {target}.
setup.titleHint: Leave it blank and the AI names the session from its content.
setup.readyHint: {source} speech will be interpreted into {target} captions.
setup.micNeed: Allow microphone access to start interpreting.
setup.targetHint: Captions and voice come out in this language.
setup.micSilent: No sound detected. Check your microphone position.
setup.autoDetectHint: Mixed languages are detected per utterance and interpreted automatically.
setup.audioOutHint: Voice translation can lag behind captions.
setup.headsetHint: Playing through speakers feeds translated audio back into the mic. Use a headset.

running.reconnecting: Restoring the connection. Captions are preserved.
running.enableSound: Click to turn on interpreter voice
running.audioWaiting: Preparing the translated voice. It plays as soon as someone speaks.
running.capWarning: The session reaches its time limit in {sec}s and will end automatically.
running.omitted: {count, plural, other {# earlier captions hidden from view}}
running.waitingSpeech: Start speaking and captions will appear here

endDialog.title: End this session?
endDialog.body: Captions disappear when you close this screen. Saved records arrive with accounts (Phase 2).

ended.title: Session ended
ended.savedNote: The transcript is saved and the AI summary is being written.

micPermission.title: Microphone access was denied
micPermission.action: Allow the microphone in your browser's site permissions, then try again.

startFailed.title: Could not start the session
startFailed.action: Check your network and try again. If it keeps failing, check the server log for the error message.

keyMissing.title: Translation engine key is not configured
keyMissing.action: Put OPENAI_API_KEY into apps/web/.env.local and restart the dev server.

connectionLost.title: Lost connection to the translation engine
connectionLost.action: The session was ended. Check your network and start again.

unsupportedPair.title: This language pair is not supported yet

guestQuota.title: You've used all your free trial characters this month
guestQuota.action: Sign up for 30 free minutes every month, then continue where you left off.

authRequired.title: Sign-in required
authRequired.action: Sign in with your Google account and start again.

meeting.title: Meeting interpreting
meeting.subtitle:
Paste a meeting link and the bot joins the call,
then posts a caption link into the chat.

botRow.title: Bot joins and posts the link
botRow.body: Once the bot joins, it posts the live caption link into the meeting chat.

meeting.urlInvalid: Check the meeting link. Zoom, Teams, Meet and Webex addresses are supported.
meeting.sourceHint: Detected automatically even when participants mix languages.
meeting.consentNotice: When the bot joins, an interpretation notice is posted in the meeting chat.

unavailable.title: Meeting mode opens in Phase 4
unavailable.body: The structure (bot join → server relay → caption link) is in place. Once RECALL_API_KEY and the Realtime Worker are connected, this screen goes live.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every interpreted conversation is saved with its transcript and AI summary.
sessions.emptyHint: Start interpreting and the transcript plus an AI summary are saved automatically.

sessionDetail.summaryRunning: The AI is writing up the meeting. This takes a moment.

summaryFailed.title: Could not generate a summary
summaryFailed.action: The full transcript below is saved. Start a new session if you need the summary again.

viewer.consentNotice: This conversation is recorded for interpretation.

waiting.title: Waiting for the caption stream
waiting.hint: Captions appear in real time once the session starts. Anyone in the meeting can open this link.

notReady.title: The viewer opens with meeting mode (Phase 4)
notReady.hint: Once the Firestore live subscription is wired up, this screen shows captions.
